how: src.evaluate.ensemble_diagnostics: four_model_average_metrics averages the ridge, random_forest, hist_gb and mlp_numpy pooled-CV predictions (src.evaluate.ensemble_cv.load_ensemble_cv) and scores them with src.evaluate.metrics.regression_metrics; member_correlation is the Pearson correlation between the hist_gb and mlp_numpy pooled-CV predictions, from the same saved files.
